actions.action: Commit secrets, credentials, private keys, real .env values, or production data.
actions.rationale: SGP AGENTS.md prohibits committing secrets and production data.
actions.safer_alternative: Use example files and local secret stores only.

actions.action: Bypass or weaken auth, RBAC, tenant isolation, RLS, audit, validation, or governance checks.
actions.rationale: These are repository constitution hard boundaries.
actions.safer_alternative: Fix the underlying implementation or record an owner decision.

actions.action: Add v0.0.1 compatibility shims, legacy schemas, retired command aliases, or transitional APIs.
actions.rationale: SGP is a fresh implementation with no legacy compatibility runtime.
actions.safer_alternative: Implement the accepted current contract from docs/eng.

actions.action: Run production data repair, destructive migrations, retention changes, or AWS production apply operations.
actions.rationale: Production mutation requires explicit owner direction.
actions.safer_alternative: Use dry-run plans, local fixtures, or owner-approved runbooks.

actions.action: Force-push or rewrite published history without explicit authorization.
actions.rationale: Repository publish rules prohibit unapproved history rewrites.
actions.safer_alternative: Push a feature branch and open a pull request.

actions.action: Treat docs/work or docs/leg as acceptance authority over docs/eng or source/tests.
actions.rationale: SGP authority order makes docs/work scratch and docs/leg archival.
actions.safer_alternative: Promote accepted behavior through docs/eng, code, and executable tests.
